payload.title: Custom domains in every plan: verification, certificates, DNS guidance
payload.description:
What: a tenant adds its own domain, proves ownership, gets a certificate, and routes to its site. Follows the subdomain launch. Amplify domain-association throttling is why this uses the edge stack pattern, not per-tenant Amplify apps.
Acceptance:
Scenario: A verified custom domain serves the tenant
  Given a tenant has proven ownership of its domain
  When a reader requests it
  Then the tenant's site is served over HTTPS
